feed.desc: Gartner raises 2026 IT spending forecast on AI demand    CFO Dive
feed.descEn: The research firm now expects global technology spending to reach $6.37 trillion this year, up 14.2% from 2025.
feed.summary:
Global information technology spending will reach $6.37 trillion in 2026, Gartner said Monday, raising its forecast as organizations ramp up their artificial intelligence investments.
“Driven by the expansion of AI workloads and demand for high-performance computing, hyperscalers and enterprises are rapidly scaling next-generation data center capacity,” Lovelock said in the Monday release.
The latest projection represents a 14.2% increase from 2025 and an upward revision from Gartner’s previous forecast of $6.31 trillion in April.

feed.descEn: After the firm's AI chief stepped down earlier this month, JPMorgan has reshuffled the ranks of its AI leadership.
feed.summary:
CEO Jamie Dimon said on a recent earnings call that there are already more than 1,000 use cases for AI, and Business Insider previously reported that JPMorgan can track individual engineers' token usage.
It's more than just job titles shifting around — JPMorgan said it's restructuring its firm-wide chief data and analytics office as it transitions from focusing on AI infrastructure to business initiatives.
The bank, with its nearly $20 billion technology budget, has been especially bullish on AI.

feed.summary:
Worldwide end-user spending on AI models and platforms is projected to total US$64 billion in 2026, up 63.4 per cent from US$39 billion in 2025, with more and more enterprises are choosing to work with companies that can provide clear value.

Taiwan’s AI-driven expansion has already accelerated overseas investment by local companies seeking to diversify production, move closer to customers and strengthen supply-chain resilience, while maintaining high-value research and semiconductor capabilities at home.

feed.desc: Why Huawei and Apple Grew While China’s Smartphone Market Fell Again in Q2 2026    IDC | Trusted Tech Intelligence
feed.descEn: China smartphone shipments fell 4.3% in Q2 2026 while Huawei and Apple grew nearly 20% each. IDC breaks down the vendor shift and outlook.
feed.summary:
China’s smartphone shipments came in at roughly 66 million units in the second quarter of 2026, down 4.3% year over year and the fifth straight quarter of decline.
Huawei and Apple moved in the opposite direction for reasons that were just as concrete.
Vendors have been cushioned so far by earlier low-cost component inventory, and as that runs down, cost pressure should land more heavily in the second half of the year.

Tijani said he looks forward to working with fellow commissioners to advance practical AI solutions that can accelerate sustainable development and deliver meaningful social and economic impact worldwide.
Nigeria’s Minister of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, Bosun Tijani, has been inaugurated as a founding member of the AI for Good Global Commission, a new high-level international body established by the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) to promote trusted, inclusive and globally coordinated approaches to artificial intelligence.

feed.desc: PC shipments fall in Q2 after two-year growth - IDC    Telecompaper
feed.descEn: Global PC shipments fell for the first time in two years in the second quarter of 2026, hit by a growing memory chip shortage, according to the latest data from IDC. Shipments declined 4.9 percent year-on-year to 68.2 million units, ending nine consecutive quarters of growth, as vendors pulled forward inventory to mitigate supply constraints. Shortages in memory and other components, alongside geopolitical pressures, continued to weigh on the market, added IDC.

feed.descEn: Gartner projects global data center electricity use hitting 565 TWh in 2026 and topping 1,200 TWh by 2030.
feed.summary:
Global data center electricity consumption will grow 26% in 2026 to reach 565 terawatt-hours (TWh), up from 447 TWh in 2025, according to a recent Gartner forecast that names power availability as a binding constraint on AI expansion.
Hyperscalers have moved in the same direction, with Meta having signed deals for more than 6GW of nuclear power to supply its upcoming data centers, and one firm repurposing retired U.S.
Wang said infrastructure and operations leaders should prioritize efficiency upgrades, secure grid access, and invest in high-efficiency cooling and edge computing to manage the constraint.

feed.title: AI won’t cut jobs, it’ll multiply them: Gartner
feed.titleEn: AI won’t cut jobs, it’ll multiply them: Gartner
feed.titleKo: AI는 일자리를 줄이는 것이 아니라 늘리는 것이다: Gartner
feed.desc: AI won’t cut jobs, it’ll multiply them: Gartner    Channel Dive
feed.descEn: As AI reshapes roles, 60% of organizations will restructure into smaller teams by 2029, the analyst firm said.
feed.summary:
By 2029, 60% of organizations will implement smaller software engineering teams , up from 15% in 2026, according to projections published this week by Gartner.
With the shift toward smaller, more specialized teams, Camacho added that hiring junior talent is especially important.
Camacho said the strategy is ideal for organizations with product operating models, rather than project-based structures, working in conjunction with platform engineering teams that provide workflows and support for the smaller units.

feed.desc: OpenAI Lands $520 Million Line of Credit From Bank of America    PYMNTS.com
feed.descEn: Bank of America has reportedly given OpenAI a $520 million line of credit ahead of its planned initial public offering (IPO).
feed.summary:
Bank of America has reportedly given OpenAI a $520 million line of credit ahead of its planned IPO.
In other artificial intelligence news, new PYMNTS Intelligence research with Splitit suggests that if AI shopping assistants become responsible for suggesting financing options, providers will increasingly compete to satisfy algorithms that consider cost, credit impact and consumer preferences before offering a recommendation.
According to Reuters, the loan makes Bank of America one of OpenAI’s biggest lenders and boosts its standing in financing AI-related capital projects, the source said.

다른 인공 지능 뉴스에서 Splitit의 새로운 PYMNTS Intelligence 연구에 따르면 AI 쇼핑 도우미가 금융 옵션 제안을 담당하게 되면 제공업체는 추천을 제공하기 전에 비용, 신용 영향 및 소비자 선호도를 고려하는 알고리즘을 충족시키기 위해 점점 더 경쟁하게 될 것임
